parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: AP2127K-3.3TRG1 supplies up to 300 mA (p.5) compared to TLV75733PDBVR at 1000 mA (p.4); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: AP2127K-3.3TRG1 requires Vin,min >= 2.5 V (p.4) vs 1.45 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP2127K-3.3TRG1: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C TA) vs TLV75733PDBVR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ)); AP2127K-3.3TRG1 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AP2127K-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-5) and TLV75733PDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because Iout,max rating drops >=20%; Vin,min floor rises 1.05 V; ambient temperature grade differs (-40..85 °C vs -40..125 °C). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 63.8 °C on AP2127K-3.3TRG1 (θJA 250 °C/W) vs 58.9 °C on TLV75733PDBVR (θJA 231.1 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 2.4x ratio (60 µA (p.5) vs 25 µA (p.5)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP2127K-3.3TRG1 "High 250 °C/W SOT-23-5 θJA Caps Continuous Power at 400 mW (25°C) — Derate From 5 V" (p.13) and TLV75733PDBVR "Severe 231.1 °C/W DBV Thermal Wall Blocks 1 A Load From 5 V Input (Use DYD Exposed-Pad Variant)" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose AP2127K-3.3TRG1 when low Vin-Vout headroom requires 170 mV dropout; choose TLV75733PDBVR when load current exceeds 300 mA (up to 1000 mA) or battery sleep budget demands 25 µA Iq. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
